title: SCA Minhag of the Week 181: "The Sebbit: Singing Before an Aliya in the Synagogue"

chapters.title: Pizmon for Happy Occasions
chapters.about: Pizmon sung for people with happy occasions before an Aliya

chapters.title: The Role of the Misader
chapters.about: The Misader announces the person and signals the Hazan

chapters.title: Specific Pizmonim for Occasions
chapters.about: Songs for a baby girl, engagement, Hatan, Bar Mitzvah, and grandfather

chapters.title: Maintaining the Tune of the Day
chapters.about: Happy occasion songs do not change the tune of Shabbat

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the practice of singing a Pizmon before an Aliya in the synagogue for people celebrating happy occasions. He explains the role of the Misader, the specific songs sung for events like the birth of a baby, an engagement, a wedding, or a bar Mitzvah, and how these songs do not change the tune of the day.
questions: What is sung when someone with a happy occasion goes up for an Aliya?
Who is the Misader and what does he do?
What specific songs are sung for different happy occasions?
Does a happy occasion song change the tune of the day?
